reviews.x: After using this product for awhile now, here's some thoughts. It definitely does the job you need it to, however, the material is a little itchy for sensitive skins. Suctions were really good if you follow the directions on cleaning up the area you want to place it at. The gift bath bombs weren't really my favorite. I spent more time cleaning up the left over crushed flora from the bath bombs and the overall texture of the soap mixture in the water was a little.. slimy? Maybe oily is better, ju

Update 05Oct2020: I used the lavender bath bombs last night and remembered to take pictures of the water this time. The lavender bomb really did make my water a very pretty purple. When I used the eucalyptus bath bomb, it really did my water a really pretty blue green color. My tub didn’t stain, nor did my bath billow. And since I got rid of the horrendous item that I kept having to mess with that caused me to make the pillow keep sliding, the pillow stayed put this time. I HIGHLY recommend this

This makes bathing more comfortable, especially if you take a lot of detox baths. It sticks well, and then I just hang it up on the shower head to drip dry. I wring it quickly as well, if I remember. Just once I saw a few specks of black  developing and I sprayed it with vinegar window spray which i keep in the bathroom, and it went away. Now I just need to find something to use under my bony tailbone.

I really like this bath pillow.  It is bright white, comfortable and affordable.  I also love that it comes with a pack of bath bombs and a case.  The reason I took off one star is that it has a weird chemical smell when you take it out of the packaging.  Would definitely recommend though.

My old bath pillow was pitiful, compared to this. I love how low the pillow extends. And how cushy and comfortable it is. My bath feels like a spa now! And I love that it comes with 4 bath bombs. Such a steal! Get this. You won’t regret it.

I thought for sure I had already reviewed this, but apparently not- so I have to now so I can absolutely Rave about this product. I am not really a bath person and when I do draw a bath its to ease a migraine, so comfort is paramount. I have tried other bath pillows before and they were quite disappointing, so I was dubious with this at first. I was using a rolled up towel for a bath pillow, but wanted something a bit nicer. This pillow sticks easily to my tub/didnt slide around and drains water well. So far I have taken like 5-8 baths without washing it and it doesnt smell or have discoloration from the water line / bath salts. I like that it is a bit longer so that when I get into the bath and lean back before the water is high my back isnt touching the coldness of the tub. I wish the sides of the pillow were just a bit less thick w

reviews.t: Awesome Product and LOVE the Bath Bombs!
reviews.x: I was SO pleasantly delighted with my purchase of this bath pillow + the 4 bath bombs!  Its presentation was GORGEOUS and VERY giftable!  It comes with a cute white carry-bag and the bath bombs (which are all natural - which I love).  The bath bombs are bright and beautifully boxed!  The bath pillow itself is amazing because I had specifically been looking for one that would work well in a tight wall-to-tub space (I do NOT have a free-standing, gorgeous, claw-footed bathtub that most of the pict

The top two auction cups have fallen off after only using this product (carefully!) for 2 months, around once a week. The fabric around where the auction cups attach just ripped completely, and the cups are only held on by the base being trapped in what's essentially a button hole. So once the fabric loosens, they fall right out. I'm not even sure if I can repair this since the mesh fabric can't easily be sewn. Until this happened, the pillow was very comfortable and stuck pretty well well aside

reviews.t: Head Rester Since Foreverrrr....... YET NIT AS I THOUGHT
reviews.x: Oh How I NEEDED This. As Much As I Am In My Shower For Many Hours, This Was Well Needed. Also, The Bath Bombs Smells Amazing ‼️‼️‼️ I Think That Is What Took The Cake. A Great Gift To Give As It Is Packaged With Care And A Nice Size Zipper Bag. It's Worth The Price . . . . UPDATE: The 0NLY Thing Amazing About This Product Is The Bath Balls. I Got Excited Before Using The Head-Rest. The Suction Doesn't Stay Put And It Isn't That Soft Either Since It Moves When I Move

reviews.t: Good pillow but suction cups fell off immedaitely
reviews.x: So I bought this product and I was so happy because it was very comfortable. About a week later, I was in the tub and when I went to take it off the tub to hang dry, three of the six suction cups were still on the back of the bathtub. I did not rip it or pull hard. Then a day later and another one did the same thing. They are not really sewn into the pillow that well but its very comfortable and I love the bath bombs that came with it.

I do not suggest purchasing this item. It is comfortable but the suction cups do not stay imbedded in the product. They pulled out within the first month of use.  I was very careful in removing the pillow from my tub after use thinking that the suction cups would pull out. I contacted the company with my complaint but never heard back from them. Do not purchase this item.

This is a very nice bath pillow. It was exactly what I was looking for , without being too pricey. It is comfortable and the suction grips on the back of the pillow are strong and adhere well. It was packaged in a very cute zip case and comes with a set of bath bombs. It is an amazing little bundle that is perfect for giving as a gift or keeping for yourself! :)

The bath bombs are soo amazing and smell so good. I’m ordering more ASAP. The pillow is so comfortable. The suction cups actually hold up. Easy to clean. Even has a hook to hang up to dry/store. My kids even ask for it during bubble bath time. Came on an adorable bag great idea for gifting. Christmas, new mom, Mother’s Day. Even “me time” gifts. Worth it!!

I like everything about this. It was very comfortable in the tub. The bath bombs were very enjoyable as well. Their size and scents were on point. Everything was packaged so well. I love that it all came in a zippered bag with a wash bag and bath bombs included! What else could one want? Thank you very much I'm very pleased with this product.

Nice, comfy bath pillow; and I like that it can go into washing machine. If only I could get the suction cups to hold!  I read and followed all the included instructions carefully but can seldom get more than one or two of the cups to "grab." As a result I must constantly readjust the positioning of the pillow. Bath bombs are a nice extra.

with this bath pillow! I expected another inflatable, but this pillow is not! It is cushy in all the right places. It comes with a hook at the top. I attached a Command Hook to my shower wall and it hangs nicely for drainage. The bonus bath bombs are a nice surprise. Even my husband likes to use it. I highly recommend this item.

I got this for myself and it is really nice. It’s comfortable, stays put and the included bath bombs are wonderful!!! This was packaged so nicely that I decided it was perfect to send as a birthday gift! I’ve already sent one and have several other people in mind as well. Highly recommend!

OK.. bath pillow is fantastic.  Packaging is top notch,  even comes with a separate bag to wash/dry the pillow to prevent damage. But why, OMG why, don't they sell the bath bombs separately?? Consumable repurchase item there... pillow VERY comfortable in my vintage straight back tub!!

This pillow was amazing! I was really impressed with the quality and how strong the suction is. It's so comfortable in my bathtub and really makes a difference. The packaging is awesome and the bath bombs that come with it are wonderful. This would make an amazing gift!

It’s a wonderful product but more wonderful than the product was the customer service! With our first package there was an issue but Derek & Abby were quick to respond and rectify the issue! Thank you so much for the product and for your wonderful assistance!

I love my Billie Bean bath pillow! It makes bath time so much more comfortable and relaxing.  It also comes with 4 sample bath bombs and I’ve used 3 already! They smell great.  I definitely feel more relaxed after my baths now that I have the pillow.

I purchased this pillow for myself, I was so happy with how large and comfortable it is. it does not move when you are laying on it and the pillow is very soft and comfortable. I am  very happy with this product I would recommend it

Good quality and the bath bombs were such a nice addition! I regret my previous purchases of cheap inflatable cushions...of which I probably bought 3 or 4 in a year because they kept tearing. Just get this one and you’re all set.

reviews.t: Horrible pillow  not comfortable and color that was bought doesn't last.
reviews.x: The bath pillow suction cup did not stick and the pillow turned dirty yellow. The pillow did not wash clean even with washing. Will not buy ever again I should have sent back. Horrible pillow and not very comfortable at all.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the pillow as comfortable and spa-like, making baths more enjoyable.
The included bath bombs are widely praised for their scents and colors, and the packaging is considered cute and giftable.
Suction cups are a common point of failure, with several reviewers reporting they detached or ripped out after short use.
Many reviewers report the suction cups adhere well and hold up when the surface is cleaned properly.
A few reviewers note a chemical smell out of the packaging or itchy material.
